Trump, Rubio reportedly considering firing US envoy to Greece

US President Donald Trump and Secretary of State Mike Pompeo are reportedly considering the dismissal of US ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, following multiple reports alleging improper conduct. Sources described Trump and Pompeo as "extremely pissed off" by the reported behavior.
